source.label: observations/N1496910582_1_CALIB.LBL
source.encoding: little-endian PC_REAL I/F after the pinned 8192-byte image header

existingPointingFit.method: Measured-axis illuminated limb and terminator fit with OPUS observer/Sun geometry; north fixed independently by Cassini CK/BPC

surfaceControlCheck.result: No independently identifiable surface feature survives within the approximately 8 by 13 pixel illuminated disc. The checked crop is a smooth limb-to-center brightness field; the available contrast is insufficient to fit a surface landmark or validate a model rotation/translation beyond the existing limb fit.

decision: Keep the existing source image and its documented coarse patch available for review, but do not promote the limb-only fit to controlled image-to-shape registration. A new mapping claim requires a higher-resolution source or an independent surface control record.
